_note: 내러티브(이야기) 지문이므로 학술 유형(주제/주장/요지/제목/빈칸/함축/무관)은 만들지 않고 order/insert/grammar/vocab/summary/writing 만 작성한다. 등장인물은 Anna 와 Mrs. Pike 로 고정, 따뜻하고 시험 적합한 톤 유지.

order.given: As part of a kindness project, Orange High School students wrote cheerful letters to elders in a countryside village. Anna wrote to Mrs. Pike, sharing about her balcony garden and including drawings of flowers, and her letter ended by hoping that Mrs. Pike also had a nice garden.

blocks.A: A few weeks later, a package arrived at Anna's door. Inside she found a jar of homemade strawberry jam and a note in which Mrs. Pike confessed that she had stopped gardening after her husband died, but that Anna's letter had moved her to plant herbs once more.
blocks.B: Touched by the reply, Anna kept writing back, and the two exchanged letter after letter about seeds, soil, and the small joys of tending a garden through the changing seasons.
blocks.C: Finally, when her class visited the village that spring, Anna and Mrs. Pike gardened together side by side, and from that shared afternoon grew a warm friendship that lasted for years.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(편지 보냄) 뒤에 (A) 'A few weeks later' 답장·잼 도착, 이어 (B) 'Touched by the reply'로 편지 왕래가 계속되고, 마지막에 (C) 'Finally ... that spring'으로 마을 방문·함께 정원 가꾸기·우정으로 마무리된다. 시간 연결어(A few weeks later → Finally)와 지시어(the reply)가 (A)-(B)-(C) 한 가지 순서만 자연스럽게 만든다.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'the reply'는 (A)의 답장을 받은 뒤라야 가리킬 대상이 생기므로 (B)가 (A)보다 앞설 수 없고, (C)의 'Finally'는 마지막 단락이므로 가운데나 앞에 올 수 없다.

insert.insert_sentence: Inside, she found a jar of homemade strawberry jam and a folded note.

passage_marked.text: As part of a kindness project, Anna wrote a cheerful letter to Mrs. Pike, an elder in a countryside village.
In it she described her small balcony garden and added a few drawings of flowers.
A few weeks later, a package arrived at her door.
The note explained that Mrs. Pike had stopped gardening after her husband died, but that Anna's letter had inspired her to plant herbs again.
Deeply moved, Anna wrote back, and the two became close friends who loved gardening.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장 'Inside, she found ...'는 소포가 도착한 직후 그 안의 내용물을 설명한다. 'A few weeks later, a package arrived'(③ 앞) 바로 뒤, 즉 ③ 자리에 들어가야 다음 문장의 'The note'(접힌 쪽지)로 자연스럽게 이어진다.
insert.distractor_ko: 소포 도착(③ 앞) 전에는 'Inside'가 가리킬 상자가 없고, ③ 뒤 문장은 그 안의 'note'를 이미 전제하므로 주어진 문장이 그 사이에 와야 한다.

passage: As part of a kindness project, Anna wrote a cheerful letter to Mrs. Pike, who lived in a countryside village.
In the letter she described her balcony garden and included some drawings of flowers.
She mentioned that, despite having limited space, she enjoyed taking care of her plants.
A few weeks later, a package arrived at her door, addressing to Anna in careful handwriting.
Inside it she found a jar of homemade jam and a note written by Mrs. Pike.
The note said that Anna's letter had inspired her to start gardening again.
Deeply moved, Anna continued writing to Mrs. Pike every month.
When her class visited the village, the two of them planted seeds together and became close friends.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 소포(a package)는 '주소가 적히는' 대상이므로 수동 관계의 과거분사가 필요하다. 능동의 'addressing'은 틀렸고 'addressed to Anna(Anna 앞으로 적힌)'가 옳다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①선행사 Mrs. Pike를 받는 주격 관계대명사 who lived, ②과거동사 included, ③enjoy + 동명사 taking, ⑤continue + 동명사 writing 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: As part of a kindness project, Anna wrote a cheerful letter to Mrs. Pike, an elder in a countryside village.
She shared about her balcony garden and mentioned that, despite limited space, she enjoyed taking care of her plants.
A few weeks later, a package arrived, and inside Anna found a jar of homemade jam.
In the enclosed note, Mrs. Pike confessed that she had stopped gardening after her husband died.
Anna's letter, she wrote, had reminded her how much she missed it, so she had planted herbs again.
Deeply moved by the reply, Anna kept writing to Mrs. Pike every month.
When her class visited the village, Mrs. Pike ignored Anna and the two became close friends.
Together they planted seeds, and from that day a warm friendship grew between them.
vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ 두 사람이 가까운 친구가 되는 따뜻한 흐름에서 Pike 부인이 Anna를 '무시했다(ignored)'는 정반대 낱말이다. 두 팔 벌려 맞이했다는 맥락이므로 'greeted(맞이했다)'가 옳다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①밝은(cheerful), ②제한된(limited), ③고백했다(confessed), ④일깨웠다(reminded)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: As part of a kindness project, Anna wrote a warm letter to Mrs. Pike and shared about her small balcony garden.
A few weeks later, a package arrived containing homemade jam and a note from Mrs. Pike.
In the note, Mrs. Pike revealed that she had given up gardening after losing her husband.
Anna's cheerful letter, however, had inspired her to plant herbs once more.
Touched by the reply, Anna kept writing, and the two shared their love of gardening through many letters.
When Anna's class finally visited the village, she and Mrs. Pike planted seeds side by side.
From that shared garden grew a warm and lasting friendship.
A simple letter, it turned out, could bring a lonely heart back to life like a plant in the sun.
summary.summary_template: A student's kind letter led a grieving woman to take up __(A)__ again, and through this shared interest the two built a lasting __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: Anna의 친절한 편지가 Pike 부인이 다시 (A)정원 가꾸기(gardening)를 시작하게 했고, 그 공통 관심사를 통해 둘은 오래가는 (B)우정(friendship)을 쌓았다. ③ gardening / friendship 이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 요리·글쓰기·여행이 아니라 정원 가꾸기, (B)는 경쟁·사업이 아니라 우정이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Anna는 공간이 제한적임에도 자신의 식물을 돌보는 것을 즐긴다고 언급했다.
writing.answer: Anna mentioned that despite having limited space she enjoyed taking care of her plants.
writing.explanation_ko: mentioned that 명사절, despite + 동명사(having), enjoy + 동명사(taking care of) 구조.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 편지는 Anna가 다시 허브를 심도록 그녀에게 영감을 주었다.
conditions: inspire + 목적어 + to부정사 형태를 사용할 것
주어는 The letter 로 시작할 것
writing.answer: The letter inspired her to plant herbs again.
writing.explanation_ko: inspire + 목적어(her) + to부정사(to plant)의 5형식. again으로 '다시'를 표현.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: In the note, Mrs. Pike revealed that she had given up gardening after losing her husband.
writing.answer: 그 쪽지에서 Pike 부인은 남편을 잃은 후 정원 가꾸기를 포기했었다고 밝혔다.
writing.explanation_ko: had given up(대과거, 밝힌 시점보다 이전), give up + 동명사(gardening), after losing(전치사 + 동명사).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Anna's kind letter encouraged Mrs. Pike to return to (A)___________, and the two slowly built a lasting (B)___________ rooted in their shared garden.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) Pike 부인은 멈췄던 정원 가꾸기(gardening)로 돌아왔고, (B) 두 사람은 정원을 매개로 오래가는 우정(friendship)을 쌓았다.
